description.value: A 135-seat community theatre and performing arts venue housed in a 1940 RCAF Recreation Hall near Jericho Beach, operated by the non-profit Friends of Jericho Arts Centre Society. It is home to the resident United Players of Vancouver and hosts a rotating roster of guest theatre companies, visual artists, and film productions. Situated just off NW Marine Drive within the Jericho Beach park area, it sits along a popular Vancouver cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (11 spaces) at 17m; rack (10 spaces) at 91m. Total: 21 spaces.
